name: Align Your Gaussians (AYG)
definition: A method realizing text-to-4D synthesis and deformation, employing dynamic 3D Gaussians with deformation fields, starting with 3D-aware diffusion model and text-to-image model for initial 3D shape, then employing text-to-video diffusion model for motion and text-to-image model for visual quality.
summary: Align Your Gaussians is a text-to-4D method generating dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes by using a text-to-video diffusion prior for motion capture, distinguishing it from methods requiring driving videos.
